description:
Manage person files under the vault's people directory.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list person files, open only by default
  show PERSON [--json] — show a single person file
  new [--name NAME] [--category CATEGORY] — create a person file
  delete PERSON [-y] — permanently delete a person file

Flags:
  list: QUERY is an optional fuzzy search ranked by similarity; --all includes closed people; --json emits JSON.
  show: PERSON is the full name, matching the filename without .md; --json emits JSON.
  new: --name full name; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary.
  delete: -y skips the confirmation prompt.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Igor Petrov", "--category", "professional"]
  ["delete", "Igor Petrov", "-y"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts on stdin for any of --name and --category not supplied; always pass both.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is given, and permanently removes the file.
  People are link targets only; a person can never be the thread of a note. A task assignee must already exist here or `tasks set-assignee` exits 1.
